source_boundary.selection: Only visible agent_message events and command_execution tool activity/outcomes are used for recorded build copy. No exposed reasoning summaries are used. The source experiment is read-only and was not run for this adaptation.
source_boundary.event_reference: Source keys below are item.id values in event.type=item.completed. received_at_utc is the recorder receipt timestamp, not a measured execution start or feature completion time.
source_boundary.interpretation: The recorder reports about 800 seconds (13 minutes 20 seconds), not 120 seconds. Its successful CLI exit is not proof of browser, native, physical installation or security acceptance. Recorded outcomes have not been rerun here. No token-to-water measurement is inferred.

adaptation.quotation_policy: All visitor messages are authored or editorially adapted, not literal agent quotations. Exact historical source excerpts remain in sources for traceability; short retained error phrases do not make a whole row verbatim.
adaptation.voice: Owner-requested immersive build narrative without visitor-facing recording disclosures. Mobile App is the only visitor-facing app name; the submitted idea supplies its description. The sequence is fixed and adapted from historical workflow, not a live coding agent. No app is generated, installed, tested or published for the visitor by this script.
adaptation.privacy: Visitor copy and source excerpts omit personal home directories, account identifiers, recorder thread identifiers and temporary browser-profile paths. Source event IDs and UTC receipt timestamps are retained for traceability. No launch commands, installation codes or account credentials are offered.
adaptation.safe_idea: The literal {idea} placeholder supplies the app description in recording-intro and summary-features. These two substitutions do not alter the fixed workflow. The controller owns the user/body row; QML must render substituted visitor text as plain text, not markup. No user-role rows are authored in this script.

timing.method: Authored exhibition pacing, not proportional timestamp scaling
timing.semantics: Each delay_ms is active time before that row is inserted. Final-summary rows follow the last progress row. Sensor/water pauses do not consume staged active time. Physical drainage tuning is pending.
timing.editing: An output/body row opens with an authored numbered plan. Task/body rows for scope, editors, logic tests, DOM coverage and final checks alternate with action outcomes and failures throughout. Historical feature names are generalized, not evidence that arbitrary visitor ideas were implemented. Dependency compatibility is grouped before the first tests/export recap, although the original passing tests/export preceded its successful recheck. Test outcomes are grouped into subsequent action rows. All original IDs and delays are retained.
